parent_objective: design a controlled training execution over M2248 repaired configs
blocked_by: M2248 materialized configs but did not run training
supersedes: ad-hoc manual training from repaired configs
running repaired configs without candidate checkpoint evaluation

public_gates: M2249 must design training execution without running training
M2249 must use exactly the M2248 training matrix
M2249 must keep the 5-profile x 3-seed matched panel
M2249 must keep candidate-checkpoint retention and selected-checkpoint evaluation
M2249 must keep ranking, winner selection, paper claims, finite-window-vs-GRU, and self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO outside the pre-registered training runner
do not change actor observation contract
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns M2248 materialized configs into a bounded execution design without starting training
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2248 matrix is incomplete
stop if execution design cannot preserve candidate checkpoint retention
stop if design would rank profiles before readiness floors
fallback_plan: route back to M2248 materialization repair if the matrix is incomplete
route to branch synthesis if execution design cannot stay bounded
route to config audit if reward hooks appear contract-unsafe

training_stage.stage_objective: freeze controlled execution command and guardrails before running M2248 configs
allowed_updates: M2249 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up execution manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: output directory and task id are fixed

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2249 is execution design and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2249; no wrong-history, reset-hidden, zero-history, or measured execution intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If repaired training later fails, route to result audit; do not weaken ranking or self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: prepares one bounded execution of the newly materialized repair matrix
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can produce repaired training evidence for the current-sim task-quality branch
must_synthesize_if: M2249 cannot define a bounded execution command
M2249 would rank profiles before readiness floors
M2249 would skip candidate checkpoint retention

hypothesis: A controlled execution design can run the M2248 repaired config matrix through the existing candidate-checkpoint runner without ranking or paper claims.
success_criteria: design references the M2248 training matrix
design fixes output dir, task id, next blocker, and guardrails
no reset rollout measured execution training replay private holdout ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: design uses a matrix other than M2248
design ranks profiles or selects a winner
design changes actor input contract or widens track_width

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design over M2248 materialization artifacts

decision_rule: M2249 passes if it freezes a bounded repaired training execution design without running training or ranking profiles.
